events.title: Australian Jazz Ensemble & Noosa Chorale: Ain't Misbehavin'
events.description: A collaboration between the Australian Jazz Ensemble and the Noosa Chorale featuring classic jazz standards. This event offers an intimate atmosphere for lovers of choral and swing music.

events.title: Australian Jazz Ensemble & Noosa Chorale: Ain't Misbehavin' (Matinee)
events.description: A daytime matinee performance showcasing the Australian Jazz Ensemble alongside the Noosa Chorale. Perfect for those who prefer an earlier session to enjoy swing and jazz arrangements.

events.title: Acoustic Guitar Spectacular
events.description: An showcase of diverse acoustic guitar playing styles performed by accomplished musicians. Held in the historic Majestic Theatre, this gig emphasizes virtuosity and instrumental storytelling.

events.title: Tom Baker Tribute Concert
events.description: A tribute concert celebrating the musical legacy of Tom Baker. Expect a nostalgic session of classic jazz and swing performed in a community-oriented venue.
